patterns_discovered.description: Three-tier color scheme maps to statistical percentiles: green for p0-p50 (fast), amber for p50-p80 (medium), red for p80-p100 (slow)
patterns_discovered.significance: Provides intuitive visual representation of performance relative to cluster baseline

patterns_discovered.description: Percentiles (p50, p80) calculated independently for each cluster by collecting durations within cluster scope
patterns_discovered.significance: Ensures fair comparison within cluster context rather than global comparison

patterns_discovered.pattern: Statistical helper function for percentile calculation
patterns_discovered.description: percentile_threshold() function sorts array and uses index calculation: (length-1) * percentile
patterns_discovered.significance: Reusable utility for consistent percentile computation across features

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Empty array handling in percentile calculation
gotchas_discovered.details: percentile_threshold() returns 0.0 for empty arrays to prevent panics
gotchas_discovered.impact: Color assignment will default all values above 0.0 to red if cluster has no duration data
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Ensure clusters always contain at least one duration value before rendering

gotchas_discovered.details: Function relies on sorted array; unsorted data would produce incorrect percentile values
gotchas_discovered.impact: If sorting logic changes, color assignments become mathematically invalid
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Test percentile function with known datasets to verify sorting occurs correctly

gotchas_discovered.details: Color thresholds vary by cluster; comparing colors across different clusters is meaningless
gotchas_discovered.impact: User might misinterpret green bar in slow cluster as equivalent to green bar in fast cluster
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Legend should clarify that colors are relative to cluster performance
